brief: Prioritise Northcott Springs for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is a unit of advanced age with a history of high loading, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). As the supplied documents do not cover any specific override for these instructions based on the listed cooling type, customers served, criticality, or ranking values, follow these prescribed rules plainly.
